notes: NOT A PUBLISHED DIRECTORY. This file is staging: hand-written entries for
the five plugins ADE bundles, held OUT of `index.json` on purpose. Nothing
reads it at runtime, and copying it to `index.json` is the one thing that
must not happen (README, 'Extraction').
Why it is held out. A directory entry REPLACES the bundled listing for the
same plugin id — `mergeMarketplaceCatalogue` is last-writer-wins by id — so
publishing one of these ids stops the Install button resolving the copy
bundled in the app and starts cloning the entry's `repo`. Those
repositories under `github.com/ade-plugins` do not exist yet; the packages
live in this repository under `plugins/`. Publishing these entries today
would turn a working offline install into a failing clone.
How an entry graduates. Move it into `index.json` once its repository
actually exists and serves a valid `plugin.json` at the ref the entry
names. In practice the crawler does this for you: give the repository the
`ade-plugin` topic and the next crawl lists it, at which point the entry
here is redundant and should be deleted rather than kept in two places.
What it deliberately does NOT carry is anything the crawler would have
measured: no install counts, no stars, no published or updated dates. An
omitted count renders as nothing; a zero would render as a measurement, and
nobody has measured these.
